name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/complete - The voice runtime's end-of-call report: transcript + outcome written once, then summary and mirrors
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN), called by the voice runtime once when a call ends, and re-sent from its local retry buffer when the control plane was unavailable — so the completed call's transcript and summary are persisted even if the control plane was briefly unavailable (3a853d10-54c6-4c94-9715-3655646d2a33#AC3). The tenant is resolved from the call. Body (sdk-voice-agent CompleteCallInput): status (completed | failed, default completed), turns ([{ turn_index, speaker: caller | agent | system, text, started_ms?, stt_ms?, ttft_ms?, ttfa_ms?, interrupted?, tool_calls? }], at most 2000), started_at, ended_at, duration_s, disposition?. Turns upsert on (call_id, turn_index); the summary is written once (the tenant's llm_complex via sdk-ai-gateway, extractive fallback); the call is mirrored to sdk-conversation and sdk-crm (not for test sessions); voice.call.completed.v1 is emitted once, on the transition to a terminal status. Repeating the same report is harmless. 200 { call_id, status, disposition, summary, turns }. Errors: invalid status / turns 400; unknown call 404; ended with another terminal status 409 Conflict; missing/wrong ops token 401/403.

testCases.name: The runtime reports the finished call -> turns stored, summary written, completed

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: {{static:Hi, this is the booking assistant. This call uses AI.}}

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: {{static:Please move my Friday booking to Saturday.}}

errorCases.when: invalid status, turns, timestamps or disposition
the call already ended with a different terminal status
